Sarawak Kolo Mee.note: Wheat egg noodles = gluten + egg; light soy sauce and honey-soy char siu = soy (+ wheat). Chicken, stated no pork or lard.

Kampua Mee.note: Wheat noodles stated made without egg; light soy sauce = soy + gluten. Char siu chicken.

Vegetarian Kolo Mee.note: Egg noodles (egg, wheat); light soy sauce. Vegetarian tag; not vegan because of egg.

Sarawak Laksa.note: Prawns and belacan in paste and sambal = crustaceans; toasted sesame seeds in paste (hidden); omelette = egg. Rice vermicelli, coconut milk not milk. Spicy.

Tomato Kway Teow.note: Prawns; squid; egg; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g). Rice noodles. No chilli stated.

Kuching Beef Noodle Soup.note: Yellow egg noodles = wheat + egg; chilli-soy dip = soy. Mild.

Tuaran Mee.note: Tuaran egg noodles; egg; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten; light soy sauce. No chilli.

Manok Pansoh.note: Tuak (rice wine) = alcohol, not halal. Tuak is glutinous rice + rice-based ragi yeast: no gluten or sulphites by the mirin reading (rule h). A little chilli = 1.

Ayam Pansuh Halal.note: Same bamboo chicken without alcohol. A little chilli = 1.

Vegetable Pansuh.note: Tofu = soy. Stated no alcohol, not spicy, vegan.

Sarawak Black Pepper Beef.note: Butter = milk; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten. Described as spicy (pepper).

Bubur Pedas.note: Paste has roasted peanuts (hidden); toasted coconut is not a tree nut. Minced beef. Mildly spicy = 1.

Nasi Aruk.note: Ikan bilis = fish; egg. Not spicy.

Ambuyat Set.note: Sago (no gluten); grilled fish; sambal belacan = crustaceans. Spicy.

Hinava.note: Raw mackerel = fish. Bambangan is wild mango (not a nut). Red chilli, spicy.

Midin Belacan.note: Belacan = crustaceans, so not vegetarian although it is a fern dish. Spicy.

Midin Garlic.note: Garlic and salt only, stated no belacan or oyster sauce. Vegan.

Terung Dayak Sour Soup.note: Ikan bilis = fish, so not vegetarian. Not spicy.

Kek Lapis Sarawak.note: Wheat flour, eggs, butter, condensed milk. Prune flavour: no sulphites stated.

Kek Lapis Cheese Almond.note: Wheat, eggs, butter, cheddar; almonds = tree nuts.

Gula Apong Ice Cream.note: Cream and milk; roasted peanuts on top.

Kuih Celorot.note: Rice flour, coconut milk (not milk), palm sugar. Vegan.

Pisang Goreng Cheese.note: Wheat batter; cheddar and condensed milk. No egg stated.

Kopi O Kosong.note: Black coffee, no sugar, no milk.

Calamansi Asam Boi.note: Calamansi and salted plum. No sulphites stated.

Pandan Tuak-Free Cooler.note: Stated no alcohol. Glutinous rice has no gluten.

Tuak.note: Rice wine with alcohol: not halal. Rice-based, no gluten or sulphites stated (mirin reading, rule h).

Tiger Beer.note: Beer = barley malt = gluten; alcohol, not halal.
